Tracks **Current / Average / Min / Max FPS** plus **1% low** and **0\.1% low** for real performance analysis.

**Frame-Time & Jitter Monitoring**  
Shows frame time (ms) and jitter to help identify micro-stutters and inconsistent frame pacing.

**Session + All-Time Records**  
Stores session highs/lows and maintains **all-time best/worst per character** .

### Lightweight Monitoring (Designed to Stay Out of Your Way)

**AddOn Footprint Tracking**  
Monitors **its own memory usage** with color alerts so you can detect abnormal growth early.

**Minimal Overhead**  
Built to be lightweight and efficient, with throttled updates and smart sampling so it won’t become the problem it’s measuring.

### Clean, Professional UI

**Movable Stats Panel**  
Drag it anywhere. Includes simple **close** and **reset position** controls.

**Flexible Settings**  
Right-click the minimap button or type **/fpsmon config** to tweak update rate, sampling window, thresholds, and memory/CPU sampling interval.
**Dual UI Support**  
Compatible with both the **modern Blizzard Settings UI** and the **classic options panel** (older clients).

### Handy Minimap Button

**Quick Toggle**  
Click to show/hide the stats panel instantly.

**Tooltip Overview**  
Hover for a quick snapshot of key performance info.

**Persistent Visibility**  
Show/hide state persists across reloads and relogs.  
Commands: **/fpsmon minimap show | hide | toggle  
  
**

### Commands

* **/fpsmon** — Toggle the on-screen display

### Seamless Monitoring

**Auto-Pause During Loading**  
Suspends sampling during loading screens and resumes safely once you’re back in game.

**Quiet Background Operation**  
Runs without spam, errors, or performance drop and keeps your data ready for analysis.

## Description

# 🎯 Fast FPS and Ping

# English

A **lightweight WoW addon** that shows your **FPS** and **Ping** in a movable frame and lets you clear your Lua memory with one click.  
Perfect for players who want to keep an eye on their performance and free memory easily. ⚡

* * *

## ✨ Features

✅ **Movable frame** – drag & drop anywhere on your screen  
✅ **FPS & Ping display** – updated every second  
✅ **Color-coded values** :

* 🟥 **Red** → FPS < 30 or Ping > 150 ms
* 🟨 **Yellow** → FPS 30–60 or Ping 100–150 ms
* 🟩 **Green** → FPS > 60 or Ping < 100 ms  
  ✅ **Memory clear button** – instantly calls `collectgarbage()` and prints a confirmation  
  ✅ **Frame position & visibility saved** between sessions  
  ✅ **Supports multiple languages** (EN, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT-BR, RU)

* * *

# 🎯 Fast FPS and Ping

# Deutsch

Ein **leichtgewichtiges WoW Addon** , das deine **FPS** und deinen **Ping** in einem verschiebbaren Fenster anzeigt und mit nur einem Klick den Lua-Speicher leeren kann.  
Perfekt für Spieler:innen, die Performance im Blick behalten und Speicher einfach freigeben wollen. ⚡

* * *

## ✨ Features

✅ **Verschiebbarer Frame** – einfach per Drag & Drop platzieren  
✅ **FPS- & Ping-Anzeige** – aktualisiert jede Sekunde  
✅ **Farbcodierte Werte** :

* 🟥 **Rot** → FPS < 30 oder Ping > 150 ms
* 🟨 **Gelb** → FPS 30–60 oder Ping 100–150 ms
* 🟩 **Grün** → FPS > 60 oder Ping < 100 ms
✅ **Speicher-leeren-Button** – ruft sofort `collectgarbage()` auf und gibt eine Bestätigung aus  
  ✅ **Speichert Position & Sichtbarkeit** zwischen Sitzungen  
  ✅ **Mehrsprachig** (EN, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT-BR, RU)

## Download WoW 3.3.5 Addons

World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King is undoubtedly the most popular expansion in the private server community. There are probably hundreds of international [private servers](https://felbite.com/private-servers) currently running on the **3\.3.5** version of the game. If you are one of the people that are playing on these servers, then you most probably will need a couple of addons to make your time in-game more enjoyable.

Luckily, you’ve landed on the exact page for finding the best addons for [Wrath of the Lich King (3.3.5)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Wrath_of_the_Lich_King) .
